notes.title: Refreshed UI
notes.content:
Thanks for your awesome support on this game!

I've updated some of the game's interface elements to improve its visual appeal, and now you  can zoom out by clicking the right mouse button

Have fun!

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
Hi there, and Happy New Year!

Some bugs have been squashed

notes.title: Show us your love!
notes.content: If you loved playing this puzzle game, please consider nominating it for the Autumn Steam Awards, your support will be greatly appreciated! ❤️‍🔥

notes.title: Fixed X lever's bug in Dance with Fire
notes.content:
Thanks so much for your constant support, gamers! ❤️‍🔥

In this update, I've fixed a small issue on the 3rd lever of the "Dance with Fire" level, since it was going off the bottom limit on dragging 🛠️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44363917/f74079afeab33fd8aa46c9c240728208df8f329f.png[/img]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Get ready for a new challenge 🌙
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44363917/7c8122fb6d4bf2ead3e3dfa663e276784a1adebc.png[/img]

[h2]In this new challenge, you have to find 3 pieces of the lost Moon, a golden artifact that will give you access to an extra level![/h2]

There are no hints about where or how to find the hidden pieces of the Moon, they are in some of the boxes and you need to use all your brain skills to make it

Good luck!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44363917/7148059aa690dcd52cc15691d0197517d515b7f3.png[/img]

notes.title: Fixed Achievements reset
notes.content:
Hi there, I just fixed that little issue that was resetting all your Steam achievements in case you reset the game in the Settings menu

Now you can still reset all levels, but your earned achievements will stay where they are ;)

Enjoy!

notes.title: Mystery Box is getting Achievements!
notes.content:
Hi there, thanks for your support on [b]Mystery Box: The Journey[/b], I'm happy you're having fun with the game!

Since many of you asked for [b]Achievements[/b], I'm preparing lots of them to spice up your gaming experience, and challenge your friends to achieve the same goals you've completed 🔥

NOTE: Achievements are already visible on the Store Page, anyway they'll be ready to be unlocked on the next game update (which is gonna happen these days).

Stay tuned!
